general.notes: Technology: Grey XFP. Nominal wavelength stated as 1x 1550nm; transmit wavelength 1530nm–1565nm; receiver wavelength range 1260nm–1600nm. Power budget 4–16dB. Dispersion penalty max 2dB (no paired penalized value/condition for penalty objects). Footnote 1): average power for transmitter output power, minimum input power, and overload. Footnote 2): minimum input power at 10.3Gbps, BER 1x10-12, PRBS 231-1. Operating temperature SO-XFP-ER: -0°C to +70°C; SO-XFP-ER-I: -40°C to +85°C (temp_min_c/temp_max_c reflect -ER standard range). Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Power consumption < 3.5W worst case. Protocol support includes 10GbE-LAN, 10GbE-WAN. DDM yes.
general.suggestions: Consider temp_min_c/temp_max_c as per-SKU lists when ordering codes imply distinct operating ranges (-ER vs -ER-I). Map dispersion penalty max 2dB with cd_tolerance_ps_nm 800 if a structured dispersion penalty field is desired.
